scope: User requested diesel large truck E1 and electric cargo tricycle E2 estimate; preserve fuel/electricity-only transport boundary.

tricycle.note: 6 kWh/100km uses 60V*100Ah/1000 divided by assumed 100km; published ranges do not establish a paired consumption test. Usable energy, load, weather and cycle vary.

electricity_reference.locator: PDF page 4, single-part general industrial/commercial, below 1kV, non-time-of-use rate
electricity_reference.note: Scenario uses rounded 0.8, not an asserted current tariff. No separate paid charging-service fee is assumed.

explicit_assumptions: Truck fuel 30 L/100km is an estimation scenario, not verified matched-fleet telemetry.
Battery/range ratio is only a nominal reference; charging efficiency 85% is assumed.
Electricity 0.8 CNY/kWh is assumed, informed by a dated tariff rather than current billing.
Cleaning 0.8 and tracking 0.1 CNY/use remain unmeasured process allowances.
Container 36.5 CNY and 50 uses are a historical price proxy and illustrative lifetime, not current procurement or measured survival.
Optional 5% annual capital charge is an opportunity-cost scenario; no purchase depreciation is included in this charge. One operational cycle is treated as one calendar day of capital tying.
Wages, vehicle fixed/trip charges, maintenance, battery degradation, tolls and container loss are excluded from this simplified scenario; these exclusions are not claims that costs are actually zero.
Vehicle carrying capacities, charging range, time windows and usable battery constraints have not been recalibrated or re-solved.
initial_investment_formula: 36.5*N; reported separately; do not add to allocated wear in a cash-flow total
